case_title: Anil Mishra v. State of U.P. & Ors.
neutral_facts: The accused persons were alleged to have beaten up the victim and another individual, causing injuries, and abducted the victim. The police investigated the incident and filed a chargesheet under several sections of the IPC. During the trial, the accused persons entered into a settlement agreement with the victim, which was submitted to the trial court. The trial court rejected the agreement, noting that some charges were non-compoundable and the victim was not a party to the agreement. The accused persons then filed an application with the High Court to quash the proceedings based on the settlement agreement. The High Court quashed the FIR and criminal proceedings, but the Supreme Court overturned this decision, restoring the proceedings to the trial court for further action.
